sources.title: Use of rocks as refuges by Japanese eel in artificial pond
sources.supports: Rock refuges and sand-mud burrowing in an eight-fish telemetry experiment.

sources.title: Growth, pigmentation and activity of juvenile Japanese eels in relation to temperature and fish size
sources.supports: Nocturnal activity and juvenile performance at 15, 20 and 25 C; not the lunar cycle or warmest lunar sites.

sources.title: Influence of Dissolved Oxygen on Growth of Young Eel
sources.supports: Growth/feed performance of 2-5 g eels under steady and fluctuating DO; saturation percentage conditions must not become universal mg/L thresholds.

sources.title: Genetic parameters and quantitative trait loci analysis associated with body size and timing at metamorphosis into glass eels in captive-bred Japanese eels
sources.access: Full text; abstract, introduction and rearing methods inspected
sources.supports: Closed life-cycle precedent, seawater larval rearing, larval-duration and metamorphic-trait genetics; not heritability of freshwater reproduction.

sources.title: Growth and survival of eel leptocephali in low-salinity water
sources.access: Indexed publisher abstract and FAO bibliographic abstract; direct publisher open blocked
sources.supports: Half-strength seawater larval performance; freshwater and 10% seawater failure in short trial; not egg or multigeneration success.

sources.title: Influence of salinity on morphological deformities in cultured larvae of Japanese eel at completion of yolk resorption
sources.access: Indexed publisher abstract; direct open blocked
sources.supports: Egg/early-embryo developmental differences across 24-42 psu; lowest-salinity result is not a freshwater test.

sources.title: Elemental Requirements of Rearing Seawater for Unfed Larvae of the Japanese Eel
sources.access: Full text available; abstract, results and discussion targeted; correction read
sources.supports: Unfed larvae beginning five days after hatch; salinity and elemental requirements. Correction fixes Na/Mg table punctuation and an introduction reference. Not long-term feeding or reproduction.

sources.title: Verification of reproducibility in rearing techniques using a new tank for mass production of eel seedlings
sources.supports: Three-facility juvenile outputs 560, 2269 and 1347. No annual output, cost or transfer to lunar gravity inferred.

sources.title: Effects of Culture Systems and Feed Types on Water Quality and Growth Performance of Japanese Eel
sources.access: Full text; design, conditions, outcomes and limitations inspected
sources.supports: Juvenile pellet/paste and RAS/flow-through comparison. Formulations differ and paste intake is uncertain; not an isolated feed-form effect or a universal FCR.

sources.title: Nutrient Control Design Manual
sources.supports: Oxidation-only 4.57 kg O2 and 7.14 kg CaCO3-equivalent alkalinity per kg ammonia-N nitrified. Does not supply eel respiration or installed transfer efficiency.

sources.title: Infection of newly recruited American eels by the invasive swimbladder parasite Anguillicoloides crassus in a US Atlantic tidal creek
sources.supports: Live glass-eel/elver movements can carry an eel parasite; ecological/animal-health example, not a human foodborne-parasite claim.

sources.title: Unagi no Kabayaki
sources.supports: Edomae split/skewer/grill/steam/glaze/grill sequence; no measured live-to-cooked yield supplied.

sources.title: Fish and Fishery Products Hazards and Controls
sources.access: Index and relevant parasite, harvest-area and natural-toxin guidance read in this study
sources.supports: Cooking and freezing address specific hazards; source controls remain necessary for persistent toxins and chemical contaminants.

sources.title: Ammonia in Aquatic Systems
sources.access: Official extension PDF, TAN/pH/temperature and nitrification passages
sources.supports: Temperature/pH dependence of unionized ammonia, nitrification and water-quality interpretation.

sources.title: On the oxygen consumption rate of the pond-cultured eel
sources.supports: Resting oxygen uptake is size-dependent at 25 C. Resting volumetric gas rates are not adopted as fed-stock design rates.
